description: This PHP source file defines the class `Image_Canvas_ImageMap`, which extends `Image_Canvas` to handle output as an HTML image map, supporting the addition of various shapes like rectangles, circles, polygons, ellipses, and pies, and rendering the map's HTML representation.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_ImageMap
classes.description: A class for creating HTML image maps with shapes and links, extending the Image_Canvas base class.

methods.name: _addMapTag
methods.description: Adds an <area> tag to the image map with specified shape, coordinates, and parameters.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line (and optionally creates a corresponding map area for it).

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon and optionally creates map areas for each vertex or the entire shape.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle and adds it to the image map if URL is specified.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle, adding a map area if URL is specified.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice and adds it to the image map if URL is specified.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the canvas as HTML and displays the image map if defined.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the canvas output to a specified file.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates the HTML code for the image map based on added map areas.
